 Court No. - 4
 Hon'Ble Ajit Kumar, J. 
Hon'Ble Swarupama Chaturvedi, J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the records.

2. By means of this petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution, petitioner has prayed for a
writ of mandamus to command respondent No.- 3 to take decision upon the application of the
petitioner moved for grant of license to open up buffalo meat shop.

3.  It is contended by learned counsel for the petitioner that the said license is granted as per the provisions contained under the the regulations namely Food Safety and Standards (Licensing and Registration of Food Business) Regulations, 2011.

entities.text: Food Safety and Standards (Licensing and Registration of Food Business) Regulations, 2011
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: It is further contended that under the relevant regulations no objection certificate has to be obtained either from the panchayat, municipality or corporation and the petitioner having obtained no objection certificate from the municipality, he is entitled to be granted license to run the meat shop.

4. Learned Additional Chief Standing Counsel states that since the matter is already engaging attention of the licensing authority, he may be directed to dispose of the pending claim of the petitioner as per the regulations referred to herein above.

5. In view of the above, this petitioner stands disposed of with a direction to the concerned respondent, namely respondent No.- 3 to consider and decide the pending claim of the petitioner strictly in accordance with law as expeditiously as possible preferably within a period of one month from the date of production of certified copy of this order.
